title: Pokemon TCG Japanese Raikou Tag All Stars 044/173 Card

descriptionText: This Japanese Pokémon card features Raikou, a basic stage Pokémon character. The card number is 044/173 and it belongs to the SM12a Tag All Stars series. The card is a standard size and is in Japanese language. It is a perfect addition to any Pokémon TCG collector's collection. The card is not autographed and is a basic type Pokémon card. Get your hands on this rare and unique card today!
